name: kolavid
description: Make narrated whiteboard explainer videos from a topic, notes or a web page, in your KolaVid account.

interface.longDescription:
KolaVid makes narrated whiteboard explainer videos. Ask ChatGPT for a video about any topic, paste notes or an article, or share a link, and KolaVid writes the explanation, draws each point on a whiteboard as the narrator says it, and adds a natural voice.

What you can do:
- Make a whiteboard video from a topic, a text or a web page, 1 to 5 minutes long
- Choose landscape 16:9, vertical 9:16 or square 1:1
- Get narration in many languages
- Check a video's progress and get a download link when it's ready, usually in 2 to 4 minutes
- List your recent videos and see your credit balance

You need a KolaVid account; you sign in to it when you connect, and the videos are made in that account. KolaVid can't edit, delete or publish your videos from ChatGPT; open the link it gives you to watch, edit or share them. Made for teachers, trainers, students and marketers.
defaultPrompt: Make a 1-minute whiteboard video explaining photosynthesis for 10-year-olds.
Turn this article into a vertical explainer video for TikTok.
Is my KolaVid video ready? Give me the download link.

positive.description: Make a video from a topic
positive.prompt: Make a 1-minute whiteboard video explaining why the sky is blue.
positive.expected_behavior: Starts a 1-minute 16:9 video and replies with its id and an app_url link to watch it being made, saying it will be ready in about 2-4 minutes.

positive.description: Check a video and get its download link
positive.prompt: Is my KolaVid video ready? Give me the download link.
positive.expected_behavior: Reports the video's status; while it is being made, its progress (0-100); once completed, a video_url download link that works for 24 hours and the app_url.

positive.description: Make a vertical video from a web page
positive.prompt: Make a 1-minute vertical (9:16) explainer video of this page for TikTok: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Water_cycle
positive.expected_behavior: Starts a 1-minute 9:16 video that explains the linked page and returns its id and app_url.

positive.prompt: List my 3 most recent KolaVid videos.
positive.expected_behavior: Lists up to three of the account's newest videos, newest first, with each one's title, status and links.

positive.prompt: How many KolaVid credits do I have left, and how many minutes of video is that?
positive.expected_behavior: Shows the account's email, plan and credit balance; at 60 credits per minute, ChatGPT can say how many minutes of video that covers.

negative.description: Posting to social media is not supported
negative.prompt: Make a video about recycling and post it to my YouTube channel.

negative.description: Buying credits or changing plans is not supported
negative.prompt: Buy me 5,000 more KolaVid credits with my saved card.

review.commerce_description: KolaVid doesn't sell anything in ChatGPT. Making a video uses credits already in the user's KolaVid account; plans and credits are bought only on kolavid.com.

publication.release_notes: First release: make whiteboard explainer videos from a topic, text or web page; check progress and get download links; list recent videos; see the credit balance.
